subject: Future Tech
title: Whole Brain Emulation
description: A quick win: understand Whole Brain Emulation.

hook.text: Map every neuron, every synapse, every connection in a human brain. Upload it to a computer. Run it.

buildup.text: The human brain has 86 billion neurons and 100 trillion synapses.

discovery.text: In 2024, scientists mapped a fruit fly's entire brain: 140,000 neurons and 50 million connections.

twist.text: A human brain has 600,000 times more neurons than a fruit fly. At current rates, mapping one would take millennia.

climax.text: If we did map a brain, we'd still need to understand what the connections mean and simulate them.

punchline.text: Copy the brain, run the mind. Simple idea, impossible scale—for now.

quiz.question: What milestone was achieved in brain mapping in 2024?
options: A complete fruit fly brain map
